max_limits_reached.meaning: order book side has reached maxNumLimitsPerSide, the threshold at which non-competitive orders should be removed upon adding new orders

worst_queue_multiple_orders.meaning: the worst price limit queue contains more than one order

new_order_new_limit.meaning: the new order being added introduces a new limit/price queue

least_competitive_removed.meaning: the least competitive price order is removed from the order book

claims.scope: CLOB order book limit addition and non-competitive order removal at maxNumLimitsPerSide

preconditions.text: The order book side has reached maxNumLimitsPerSide, the threshold at which non-competitive orders should be removed upon adding new orders.; The worst price limit queue contains more than one order.; The new order being added introduces a new limit/price queue.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: When maxNumLimitsPerSide is reached and a new order introduces a new limit/price queue, the least competitive price order should be removed from the order book.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: The least competitive price order is not removed from the order book while it should be.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: The add_order_action is the operation during which removal of the least competitive order is expected.
The worst price limit queue is the location of the least competitive order to be removed.

limitations: The removal obligation is modeled as a Boolean outcome because the report gives no numeric identity for the least competitive order.

The condition of I uses the intent's stated qualifiers (max reached and new limit introduced); the multi-order queue fact is recorded as a precondition but not as an applicability qualifier of the intent.
